abstract: The indications for retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) after chemotherapy for nonseminomatous germ cell tumor of the testis vary widely. We reviewed our experience with 122 patients who underwent RPLND within 6 months of receiving cisplatin-based chemotherapy for bulky (greater than 3 cm) retroperitoneal metastases. Pathologic findings were necrotic tissue in 57 (47%), teratoma in 48 (39%), and residual malignancy in 17 (14%). The size of the retroperitoneal mass after chemotherapy (p = 0.001) and the degree of shrinkage that occurred with chemotherapy (p = 0.0001) were both strongly correlated with the histologic findings at RPLND. The presence or absence of teratomatous elements in the pretreatment orchiectomy specimens was only weakly correlated (p = 0.06). Multivariate logistic regression found shrinkage and the size of the residual mass to be independent predictors of finding only necrotic tissue. We were unable to identify preoperatively a group of patients in which some did not have teratoma or malignancy ultimately resected. Of 39 patients who had a residual mass less than 1.5 cm, and 43 patients whose residual mass was less than 1.5 cm or whose mass had shrunk by greater than 90%, 3 had residual malignancy, and 5 had teratoma resected. Among these 8 patients, 7 had prechemotherapy masses greater than 3 cm. Even with stricter criteria, of 17 patients with no testis teratoma initially and a residual mass less than 1.5 cm which had shrunk by greater than 90%, 5 (30%) had teratoma or malignancy resected. Postchemotherapy RPLND is recommended for all patients with a prechemotherapy mass greater than or equal to 3 cm, irrespective of the radiographic findings.
abstract_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法後の後腹膜リンパ節郭清（RPLND）の適応は、施設によって大きく異なる。我々は、精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で、シスプラチン併用化学療法後に巨大（3cm超）な後腹膜転移を有し、6か月以内にRPLNDを受けた122例を後方視的に検討した。病理所見は、壊死組織が57例（47%）、奇形腫が48例（39%）、残存悪性腫瘍が17例（14%）であった。化学療法後の後腹膜腫瘤のサイズ（p = 0.001）および化学療法による縮小の程度（p = 0.0001）は、RPLNDの組織学的所見と強く相関した。化療前精巣摘除標本における奇形腫成分の有無は弱い相関にとどまった（p = 0.06）。多変量ロジスティック回帰では、縮小の程度と残存腫瘤のサイズが、壊死組織のみであることの独立した予測因子であった。術前に、奇形腫や悪性腫瘍が最終的に切除される群を同定することはできなかった。残存腫瘤が1.5cm未満であった39例、および残存腫瘤が1.5cm未満または90%超縮小した43例のうち、3例に残存悪性腫瘍があり、5例で奇形腫が切除された。これら8例のうち7例は化療前腫瘤が3cm超であった。より厳格な基準を用いても、初診時に精巣奇形腫がなく、残存腫瘤が1.5cm未満かつ90%超縮小した17例のうち、5例（30%）で奇形腫または悪性腫瘍が切除された。化療後RPLNDは、画像所見にかかわらず、化療前腫瘤が3cm以上の全患者に推奨される。
